questions.q: In “You can borrow my umbrella,” what does borrow mean?
o: take it and return it later
questions.e: Borrow veut dire emprunter quelque chose puis le rendre.

questions.q: In “Try to avoid the muddy path,” what does avoid mean?
questions.e: Avoid veut dire éviter ou rester loin de.

questions.q: In “They discovered a small lake,” what does discovered mean?
questions.e: Discover veut dire découvrir, trouver pour la première fois.

questions.q: In “Reading every day can improve your English,” what does improve mean?
questions.e: Improve veut dire rendre meilleur ou s’améliorer.

questions.q: In “It is likely to rain this evening,” what does likely mean?
questions.e: Likely veut dire probable.

questions.q: In “We need to reduce the noise,” what does reduce mean?
questions.e: Reduce veut dire diminuer.

questions.q: In “The purpose of the meeting is to plan a trip,” what does purpose mean?
questions.e: Purpose veut dire but ou raison.

questions.q: In “Please gather the books after class,” what does gather mean?
questions.e: Gather veut dire rassembler.

questions.q: In “He wears ordinary clothes to school,” what does ordinary mean?
questions.e: Ordinary veut dire ordinaire ou habituel.

questions.q: In “The walls protect the garden from wind,” what does protect mean?
questions.e: Protect veut dire protéger, garder en sécurité.

questions.q: In “Please continue reading the story,” what does continue mean?
questions.e: Continue veut dire continuer, poursuivre.

questions.q: In “We walked instead of taking the bus,” what does instead of mean?
questions.e: Instead of veut dire au lieu de.

questions.q: In “This is a local market,” what does local mean?
questions.e: Local veut dire du coin, de cette région.

questions.q: In “I cannot afford a new phone,” what does afford mean?
questions.e: Afford veut dire avoir les moyens de payer.

questions.q: In “She refused to open the door,” what does refused mean?
questions.e: Refuse veut dire refuser, dire non.

questions.q: In “The journey took three hours,” what does journey mean?
questions.e: Journey veut dire voyage ou trajet.

questions.q: In “Our neighbourhood has a new library,” what does neighbourhood mean?
questions.e: Neighbourhood veut dire quartier.

questions.q: In “A crowd waited outside the stadium,” what does crowd mean?
questions.e: Crowd veut dire foule, grand groupe de personnes.

questions.q: In “We should protect the environment,” what does environment mean?
questions.e: Environment veut dire environnement, le monde naturel qui nous entoure.

questions.q: In “Please be patient while I find your book,” what does patient mean?
questions.e: Patient veut dire capable d’attendre calmement.

questions.q: In “My aunt gave me useful advice,” what does advice mean?
questions.e: Advice veut dire conseil.

questions.q: In “This job is a good opportunity,” what does opportunity mean?
questions.e: Opportunity veut dire occasion, chance.

questions.q: In “The team hopes to succeed,” what does succeed mean?
questions.e: Succeed veut dire réussir, atteindre son but.

questions.q: In “We should check the information before sharing it,” what does check mean?
questions.e: Check veut dire vérifier.
